South Africa male input data for 2001-2007 period

Source: R/data.R
zaf_2001_2007.Rd

Input deaths and population counts for the 2001-2007 period for males in South Africa. Comes from example here: http://demographicestimation.iussp.org/content/generalized-growth-balance-method.

Usage

zaf_2001_2007

Format

[data.table()] columns:

location

[character()]
"South Africa"

pop1

[numeric()]
Age-specific population from census 1

pop2

[numeric()]
Age-specific population from census 2

deaths

[numeric()]
Age-specific deaths recorded in intercensal period (total, not mean annual deaths)

migrants

[numeric()]
Age-specific net migration recorded in intercensal period (total, not mean annual net migrants)

age_start

[integer()]
Lower bound of 5-year age group

sex

[integer()]
"male"

date1

[numeric()]
Date of first census

date2

[numeric()]
Date of second census

zaf_2001_2007
#>         location    pop1       pop2    deaths  migrants age_start    sex
